data.name: Dawar
data.gender_notes: Dawar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From Arabic 'dawara' meaning 'to turn, revolve, or roll'. A name of power and motion. The name Dawar carries the meaning “Turning, Wheel” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Dawar usually hope their child will grow to embody turning, wheel and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the cyclical nature of life and the constant renewal of energy. It represents the endless flow of life and the interconnectedness of all things.
data.etymology: Dawar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Turning, Wheel.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dawar total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: داور
in_arabic.meaning: القاضي، الحاكم، من يقضي بين الناس
in_arabic.long_meaning: داور اسم مشتق من الفعل 'دَارَ' الذي يعني 'الدوران' و'القضاء'. في اللغة العربية، يعني داور القاضي أو الحاكم الذي يقضي بين الناس. ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سياق القضاء والحكم. تاريخياً، كان اسم داور يطلق على من يملك السلطة في القضاء والحكم في المجتمع. ومن الناحية الروحية، يعتبر اسم داور ذا أهمية كبيرة في التعبير عن العدل والإنصاف.

in_urdu.name: داور
in_urdu.long_meaning: داور ایک مشہور نام ہے جو عربی زبان کے الفاظ سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے قاضی یا حاکم جو لوگوں کے درمیان انصاف کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیاء میں خاص طور پر پاکستان اور بھارت میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان مقبول ہے۔ داور نام کی اہمیت اس کی روحانی معانی اور اسلامی تقالید سے جڑے ہونے میں ہے۔

in_hindi.name: दावर
in_hindi.long_meaning: दावर नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है और इसका अर्थ है न्यायाधीश या शासक। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में भी प्रचलित है और इसे एक पवित्र और महत्वपूर्ण नाम माना जाता है। दावर नाम की विशेषता है इसकी न्यायप्रियता और सच्चाई की भावना को दर्शाना।

in_pashto.name: داور
in_pashto.long_meaning: داور نوم د پښتو ژبې څخه دی او معنی یې د قاضي یا حاکم څخه عبارت دی. دا نوم د پښتنو په ټولنه کې د يو مهم نوم په توګه ګڼل کیږي. د داور نوم روحاني معنی د عدالت او انصاف ښودلو ته اشاره کوي.

in_english.name: Dawar
in_english.meaning: Judge, ruler, one who makes fair decisions
in_english.long_meaning: The name Dawar originates from the Arabic root 'D-W-R', which means 'to turn' or 'to judge'. In Islamic tradition, Dawar signifies a judge or ruler who administers justice. The name holds historical significance and spiritual importance, reflecting qualities of fairness, justice, and leadership. It is used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing moral integrity and authority.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Dawar" in Islamic culture represents a sense of endless rotation, continuity, and development. It can be associated with the cyclical nature of life, the ever-spinning celestial bodies, or the unending journey towards knowledge and growth. This name stands as a reminder of the constant movement and transformation within our world and the significance of embracing change.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual sense, the name "Dawar" holds deep symbolism within Islamic teachings. It represents the continuous rotation of Sirat Al-Mustaqim (The Straight Path), an essential concept in Islamic belief. As humans, our spiritual journey mirrors this cyclical motion, as we strive to maintain our balance and seek knowledge and guidance while navigating the twists and turns of life. Ultimately, it serves as a reminder to keep moving forward, trusting in Allah's guidance, as we progress towards a more enlightened and fulfilling existence.
